text:
Riley Park: Tiny design pass for metrics charts: legend behavior with long names, axis unit conventions, smoothing defaults, and handling single extreme spikes. Short thread.
Noor Ahmed: Legend: when there are >5 series it feels cramped. Proposal: allow wrapping to 2 rows or a compact mode (icons + initials). Also tooltip on hover to show full series name.
Theo Ramos: Units: prefer compact SI (k, M) on axis ticks, but tooltips should always show full integer + unit (e.g., "12,345 traces"). Avoid single-letter units like 't'.
Sana Iqbal: Outliers: saw a 25x spike in test data that compressed the rest. My pick: clip at 99th percentile + show a small inset minimap of full range. Add a dashed cap line on main chart where clipping occurs and a badge on the clipped point reading "clipped".
Riley Park: Smoothing: add explicit toggle with presets: Raw | Trend (7) | Trend (30). Default to Raw on alert pages, Trend(7) for overview. If smoothing is enabled, show faint raw overlay (dashed) to avoid hiding peaks.
Noor Ahmed: Accessibility: legend items must be keyboard-focusable (Tab), Space toggles visibility, Enter opens expanded legend. Announce changes via a live region: "Series <name> hidden". Keep hidden series in DOM at low opacity (0.12) so screen readers can still access them.
Design System Bot: Reminder: text on bg-gray-50 needs >=4.5:1. Current bronze token fails. Suggested bronze #B45A00 (contrast 4.6:1). Also ensure color-blind friendly palette.
Theo Ramos: Quick config I prototyped (for engineers) as a pasteable snippet in the thread:
```
unitMode: compact
tooltipUnit: full
smoothing: raw
smoothingPresets: [7,30]
outlierHandling: clip_99 + inset
legendMode: wrap | compact
keyboardLegend: true
```
Sana Iqbal: UX copy nits: change tooltip label from "count" to "traces"; clipped tooltip should show true value + percentile, e.g., "Value: 123,456 traces (99.8th percentile)".
Riley Park: Action items: Riley to update legend spacing and hover tooltip; Noor to write keyboard/aria spec; Theo to implement clip+inset and dashed raw overlay; Sana to draft tooltip copy and clipped-panel copy. Preview: https://preview.redwood-inference.com/metrics/legend-clip-1769 50d test with NVDA/VoiceOver. Reconvene Thursday for final review. :white_check_mark:
Noor Ahmed: I'll add unit tests for keyboard interactions.
Design System Bot: Deploy preview posted. Automated contrast checks passed for suggested tokens.
Riley Park: Thanks team, closing thread.
